articles.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
articles.title: Asymmetric Partial Hydrogenation of Quinazolines: Overcoming Catalyst Poisoning by a Robust yet Active Solo-Coordination-Vacant Ir(III) Pincer Catalyst
articles.short: Ir pincer catalyst for quinazoline reduction
articles.headline: Quinazoline hydrogenation: 98% yield, 99% ee
articles.did: A solo‑coordination‑vacant Ir(III) pincer catalyst **enables catalytic asymmetric partial hydrogenation** of quinazolines, delivering **enantioenriched 3,4‑dihydroquinazolines**.
articles.why: Product‑induced catalyst deactivation has limited quinazoline reductions; this **robust Ir(III) pincer catalyst overcomes poisoning**, allowing broad substrate scope, high yields, and ultra‑low loadings (10 ppm, TON 38 000).

term.def: A metal complex lacking any ancillary ligand that coordinates to the metal, leaving a vacant site for substrate binding.

articles.title: Direct Photocatalytic Synthesis of 1,3,4-Oxa(thia)diazoles from Aldehydes and (Thio)hydrazides
articles.headline: Acridine photocatalyst forms 1,3,4-oxa(thia)diazoles
articles.did: **Acridine photocatalyst** enables a two‑step, one‑pot synthesis of 1,3,4‑oxa(thia)diazoles from (thio)semicarbazides and aldehydes, and **radical oxidation of the in‑situ hydrazone** is supported by mechanistic studies.
articles.why: The protocol **works without molecular oxygen**, using DCE as both solvent and terminal oxidant, providing a flexible, oxygen‑independent route to heterocycles.

term.def: Compound from condensation of a hydrazide with a carbonyl, featuring a C=N–NH2 functional group.

method.line: Ir pincer catalyst for quinazoline reduction

post.hook: Ir(III) pincer works at 10 ppm, 38k TON
post.summary: Today's papers showcase catalyst robustness: an Ir(III) pincer enables asymmetric quinazoline hydrogenation at 10 ppm (TON 38 000, 99 % ee) and an acridine photocatalyst drives oxygen‑independent formation of 1,3,4‑oxa(thia)diazoles using DCE as oxidant.

quiz.q: What catalyst loading enables the reported turnover number?
quiz.why: The study uses ultra‑low 10 ppm Ir(III) pincer loading to achieve TON 38 000.
